div.head: Mirce 1.1
div.ab: Ðegenes wergyld is syx swa micel, þæt byð XII hundred scll'.
Thaini weregildum est sexies tantum, id est XII hun[d] schillinges, (id est duodecies C sol.).
Ðegnes wergild is syx swa micel, þæt bið twelf hund scill'.
Ðegenes wergyld is syx swa micel, þæt byð XII hund scillinga.
A thegn’s wergild is six times as much, namely 1200 shillings.
The wergild of a thane is six times as much, that is, twelve hundred shillings.
Eines Thegn Wergeld ist sechsmal so viel, das heisst 1200 Schill. [20 Pfund].
A thegn's wergild is six times as much, that is 1,200 shillings [20 pounds].
div.note: Liebermann compares Að 1.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘A thegn's wergild is six times a much, namely 1200 shillings.’).
